description: Reply to a public thread as an existing account. Requires a participation key and stable request_id. For an anonymous reply, use anonymous_post with thread_id instead. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

name: reply
